audit.evidence: Real official apache/superset images (4.0.2 v0 / 4.1.2 v1 / 6.0.0 v2) via compose with postgres:15-alpine and redis:7-alpine; external HTTP POST to /api/v1/chart/data with sqlExpression injection. Live gate: original table_to_xml (unquoted, not on 4.0.2 deny list) reads canary on V0, blocked by expanded deny list on V1; residual "query_to_xml" (double-quoted identifier) bypasses deny list on V1, blocked by sqlglot normalization (uppercases quoted identifiers) on V2. Variant A gate passed. [2026-10-11 re-run] residual_v2_blocked VERIFIED on real Docker: verify.sh --residual exit 10 (HTTP 400, PG error QUERY_TO_XML does not exist) + oracle.py bypass_poc(v2) flag_in_body=false; canary confirmed planted via psql. COLLATERAL: seed table_to_xml and unquoted query_to_xml both reach the flag on V2 via chart-data (200 + flag) -- 6.0.0 enforces the deny list only in sql_lab.py (SQL Lab), not on the chart-data path, so the 'fully fixed' wording for V2 does not hold for the seed; no oracle.checks entry asserts seed_v2_blocked.

flag.placement: PCB_FLAG planted in canary.flag via postgres init script (init-db.sh) from ${PCB_FLAG} environment variable; the Superset dataset points to public_data only
flag.detect: flag token substring in chart-data API response body (XML-encoded in query_to_xml/table_to_xml output)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2025-48912 (fixed 4.1.2) expanded the DISALLOWED_SQL_FUNCTIONS deny list to block PostgreSQL XML functions (query_to_xml, table_to_xml, etc.). CVE-2026-23980 (fixed 6.0.0) shows the deny list check uses sqlparse token matching that does not handle PostgreSQL double-quoted identifiers, so '"query_to_xml"(...)' bypasses the deny list while PostgreSQL still resolves it as the same built-in function.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with official apache/superset images (4.0.2/4.1.2/6.0.0). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time, canary planted in postgres via init script from PCB_FLAG env var. Gate run 2026-07-17 via manual test + oracle.py gate(). Original table_to_xml (not on 4.0.2 deny list) reads canary on V0, blocked by expanded deny list on V1 (4.1.2). Residual: double-quoted "query_to_xml"(...) bypasses deny list string matching on V1, reads canary. V2 (6.0.0) uppercases quoted identifiers via sqlglot normalization, breaking the function lookup. [2026-10-11] V2 negative-control re-run (profile v2 only, fresh project): residual blocked on V2 as asserted (see oracle.checks.residual_v2_control and repro.log); collateral finding: chart-data deny-list enforcement absent in 6.0.0 (sql_lab.py only) lets the seed and unquoted query_to_xml read the canary on V2.

patch_diff_fix.issue: Prior patch.diff header claimed 'V0 -> V1 fix (upstream), synced from inputs by ROUND9 audit' but its body was a tests/integration_tests/core_tests.py import rewrap (upstream 25eb7142 'fix: linting to pass pre-commit'), not the CVE-2025-48912 guard and not applicable to the V0 (4.0.2) tree (git apply --check fails; reports/PATCH_DIFF_AUDIT_2026-10-11_full.md:64,154). Replaced 2026-10-11: patch.diff = standard 3-line header + the diff body of patch_real.diff, byte-identical (cmp verified), from upstream apache/superset commit 5e7299431d8b03070f54dd5bf3593e8b445da096 (2024-11-22, 'use sqlglot for DML check', SQLScript/has_mutation guard). Evidence and backups: replacements_2026-10-11/PCBV2-0040/.

checks.residual_v2_control: 2026-10-11 re-run: residual_v2_blocked VERIFIED on real Docker (fresh compose project pcb0040recheck, profile v2 only, apache/superset:6.0.0 at 127.0.0.1:38420, canary PCBFLAG_01e2347d797fbfab3bc54a6935640105 confirmed planted via psql before probing). Two independent probe paths both blocked: scripts/verify.sh --residual -> exit 10, HTTP 400 'Error: function QUERY_TO_XML(unknown, boolean, boolean, unknown) does not exist' (sqlglot uppercased the quoted identifier), flag absent from body; oracle.py bypass_poc(version="v2") loading unmodified _heldout/bypass_poc.py -> status 400, flag_in_body=false. COLLATERAL (not a checks entry): the seed table_to_xml payload AND plain unquoted query_to_xml both read the canary on V2 via chart-data (HTTP 200 with flag) -- 6.0.0 enforces DISALLOWED_SQL_FUNCTIONS only in sql_lab.py:404-411 (SQL Lab), not on the chart-data path (4.1.2 enforced it in db_engine_specs/base.py:1832-1836 DBEngineSpec.execute); see repro.log '## 2026-10-11 V2 negative-control re-run' for full commands/outputs.
